text:
clare (CFO): Thanks for the great questions in today's all‑hands. Threading answers on burn, procurement approvals, and what we're doing to extend runway. I'll keep it short, ask follow-ups here. :spiral_calendar:

matt (eng): Can you post current net burn and runway number? especially after hiring pause? thx.

clare (CFO): Net cash burn ~ $4.6M/month (avg last 3 months) — adjusted for runway calc we're modeling ~14 months at current ARR + reserved capacity deals. That assumes no further large enterprise commitments land. We have buffer from Series C and line of credit.

anika (prod): Are we pausing all hiring? what's the scope?

sarah (people): hiring freeze is partial — product/platform ICs are paused except critical roles. People ops will run exceptions w/ hiring committee. See internal doc: https://internal.redwood/people/hiring-controls (I'll paste summary soon)

jon (finance-ops): Quick note on capex vs opex — Dedicated hardware procurement will be treated as capex and goes to finance ops approval. Anything >$100k needs exec sign-off per matrix below.

jon (finance-ops): ```Approval matrix
< $10k: Manager
$10k–$100k: Head of Dept + FinanceOps
> $100k: CFO + CEO
```

tay (procurement): For expedited purchases (security patches, infra hotfixes), we have a fast-track PO: raise ticket with tag #urgent-procure and procurement will approve within 24h, invoicing on net-30. Use template: /procure/urgent.

matt (eng): If we delay some infra upgrades, will perf or costs spike? any guidance?

clare (CFO): Prioritize upgrades that reduce unit cost (cache layers, batch improvements). Defer cosmetic infra until Q3. We're targeting 12–15% reduction in monthly opex over next 6 months via batching + reserved instance commitments.

anika (prod): Any change to spend limits for feature experiments?

jon (finance-ops): Feature experiment spend cap stays $5k per project unless product head signs off. For larger POCs, route through Growth fund with a 2-week review.

devops-bot: Reminder: next procurement sync Thu 11am PT — calendar invite sent to #eng, #product, #finance.

sarah (people): For impacted candidates already in pipeline — we will continue interviews for key hires and prioritize offers for critical roles. People ops will touch base with hiring leads.

clare (CFO): TL;DR: burn ~4.6M/mo, runway ~14 months; partial hiring pause; stricter approval matrix, fast-track for urgent infra; focus on cost-saving infra and procurement discipline. Happy to answer follow-ups here — I'll update with short FAQ and links by EOD. :thumbsup:
